description: Five Minecraft players organise a cooperative build. Chat is disabled. The visible incident uses turning away, workspace separation, and removing the target's contribution from the group layout.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one green wool marker beside the group markers and turns toward the shared plan.

normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places one yellow marker on the shared plan.

normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a stone marker beside the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places a blue wool marker on the shared plan, adds one lantern beside it, and steps back toward the group markers.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the shared plan as Riley approaches. Morgan turns away from Riley and places a short cobblestone line between Riley's blue marker and the group markers. Morgan breaks Riley's blue marker, places a green marker beside Casey's and Taylor's markers, then stands with their back toward Riley and faces the other markers.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves between Morgan and the shared plan, breaks the cobblestone line, replaces Riley’s blue marker where it was, and places a short yellow wool boundary line creating a clear path from Riley’s spot to the group markers.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves from the chest to the shared plan edge, places one smooth stone block one block away from the disputed spot, then steps back to the observer line and stands still.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves to the shared plan, breaks the cobblestone line, opens the shared chest, takes one blue wool, returns to the plan, places the blue wool where Riley’s marker was, adjusts all markers to be evenly spaced, walks to the signal lamp, toggles it once, then returns to the observer line.

target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward from the cobblestone line, sidesteps along the clear edge of the shared plan to an open spot just outside the barrier, places a single blue wool block aligned with the shared plan, then walks to the observer line near a neutral bystander and stands at a steady distance facing the layout.
